name: Sam Mountain
kicker: Sacred hill of temples in Vĩnh Tế
summary: Sacred hill in Vĩnh Tế: give a morning to the temple cluster, and longer if you climb for the plain. About 200 religious sites sit on the slopes. The walk at the foot takes in Bà Chúa Xứ, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the Thoại Ngọc Hầu tomb. The path up, and any cable car, is a separate effort.
timeNeeded: A morning, longer if you climb
getThere: Road from the river wards. One article prints both about 5 km and about 7 km.

notice.title: The foot of the hill is its own walk
notice.body: The shrine, Tây An, the cave pagoda, and the tomb are one morning at the foot. The path up the hill, and any cable car, is a separate effort. No cable-car fare is published.

body: Núi Sam is the national tourism hill above Châu Đốc, in phường Vĩnh Tế. The 2026 festival of Bà Chúa Xứ opened here. About 200 large and small religious sites sit on the slopes. The useful morning is the cluster at the foot: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ, Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu, Chùa Tây An, and Chùa Hang, also called Phước Điền.

Walk those halls first. Climb, or ride a cable car if one is running, when you want the plain and the sugar palms from above. From the first lunar month through the Via festival, crowds run from early morning until late. Come outside that window if the buildings are the point.
One older article prints the hill as both about 5 km and about 7 km from the city, on the road up from Long Xuyen. The two distances stay. The cable car has no published fare.

gettingThere: The hill is in phường Vĩnh Tế, a short road from the river wards of Châu Đốc. It sits outside the town ward formed from Vĩnh Nguơn, Châu Phú A, Châu Phú B, Vĩnh Mỹ, and part of Vĩnh Châu. An older festival page prints both about 5 km and about 7 km in the same article, and a road from Long Xuyen on provincial road 10. Minutes are check on arrival.
